notes: Adds Playnite.Core.Library.PagedLibraryReader, PagedLibraryQuery and PagedLibraryComparer: one SQLite snapshot with ORDER BY, LIMIT and OFFSET in SQL, a required bounded limit, and the stored identity as the final ascending tie-breaker. Pages load only the requested game graphs, not the full library; an instrumented session seam proves a page of N reads only the N-row window. Text keys use SQLite NOCASE and PagedLibraryComparer is the exact in-memory mirror; numeric, date and flag orders match LibraryService. This is a paging primitive only: no production caller is wired, list/search still read the full snapshot, and wiring it into LibraryService is a p6-001 follow-up. Additive to LibraryService and GameRepository, which stay unchanged; filters, v10 text search and grouping remain p6-001/p6-011.
